Replace diagnostic red/white skin dithering with coherent peach fills. Preserve each hand attachment and the hidden far-side anatomy; do not add extra limbs or expose hidden eyes. One bare foot is lifted and points left through the loop near center-lower, other stands/extends at bottom-center. Keep compact turning pose and left fin orientation. No detached hands or extra legs.
Anatomy check before output: Johnny has exactly two arms attached to his shoulders, each hand connects to ONE sleeve at wrist. Mermaid has exactly two arms. Respect hidden hands, no floating hands. Output whole source silhouette with transparent margins; no scenery, water, floor, labels, border, checkerboard, glow or gray ground shadow. Exact original overrides prose ambiguity; single sprite.
